product: Memory (DRAM, NAND, HBM3E and HBM4), foundry/logic (4nm LPUs, 2nm development) and DX devices (Galaxy smartphones and foldables, TVs, appliances). The DS division drives profit, foundry is recovering toward profit, and DX is lossmaking.
demand: AI datacenter and inference buildout drives high-capacity memory and HBM4 demand; Samsung says 2026 HBM supply is sold out and it ships HBM4 for Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform. Multi-year hyperscaler contracts underpin multi-year revenue visibility.
pricing_power: Strong today: DRAM and NAND ASPs are rising with supply tight into 2028 per Yuanta, giving unusual pricing power. But long-term agreements covering 60-70pc of capacity cap upside when spot prices spike, and component inflation squeezes Samsung's own DX margins.
competition: SK hynix leads HBM and contests HBM4 leadership; Micron competes in commodity and HBM memory; TSMC dominates foundry while Samsung pushes 4nm/2nm AI logic. Chinese memory makers add longer-term supply risk, and in devices Samsung fights Apple and Chinese OEMs.
team: Chairman Lee Jae-yong leads; the board approved the KRW90-110tn 2026 shareholder return and a KRW15tn employee-compensation buyback. No executive or management changes were disclosed in the sources read, so team detail is largely not found.
market_strategy: Lock 60-70pc of DRAM and NAND capacity into multi-year contracts with hyperscalers to damp the cycle, ramp HBM4, restore foundry profitability, and return 50pc of free cash flow (KRW90-110tn in 2026). The next three-year shareholder return policy is due in January 2027.
bull: Jul 30 2026 Samsung reported 2Q26 operating profit KRW89.5tn, up 1814pc YoY on HBM and DRAM/NAND prices; 60-70pc of capacity is locked in multi-year hyperscaler LTAs and HBM4 revenue triples QoQ in 3Q26.
bear: Kiwoom cut 3Q26 revenue to KRW198tn and operating profit to KRW107tn on Sep 23 2026; FnGuide consensus fell 2.6pc on revenue and 4.4pc on operating profit over three months; DRAM ASP growth decelerates from 16.5pc to 5.4pc and DX posted a KRW0.8tn 2Q26 loss.
falsifier: The 3Q26 earnings release on Oct 29 2026 showing operating profit below KRW107tn or HBM4 revenue not tripling QoQ would prove the bull case wrong.
web_what_changed: Aug 21 2026 board approved record KRW90-110tn 2026 shareholder return incl ~KRW30tn 3Q26 cash dividend and KRW15tn employee buyback; Jul 30 2026 2Q26 operating profit KRW89.5tn up 1814pc YoY on HBM and DRAM/NAND prices; 60-70pc of DRAM/NAND capacity locked in multi-year LTAs; HBM4 revenue tripling QoQ in 3Q26; Sep 23 2026 Yuanta raised target to KRW630000; KRX close KRW285500 up 3.25pc.
web_not_known_yesterday: No company disclosure dated Sep 24-25 2026 was found. Latest hard facts are from Sep 23 2026: KRX close KRW285500 up 3.25pc, first close above KRW280000 since July 10; Yuanta raised its target to KRW630000 from KRW530000; Kiwoom cut its standard DRAM price-growth assumption to 12pc from 20pc.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Primarily price, with a volume/mix kicker. Yuanta expects 3Q and 4Q DRAM prices up 18pc and NAND up 16pc; Mirae Asset sees DRAM ASP up 16.5pc QoQ in 3Q26 then up 5.4pc in 4Q26. Mix/volume comes from HBM4: 3Q26 HBM4 revenue more than triples QoQ.
web_suppliers: Key inputs are EUV/High-NA lithography from ASML, wafer-fab equipment, and HBM materials/base dies; BofA noted accelerating High-NA EUV adoption on Sep 8 2026. The binding constraint is memory capacity itself, not components: HBM consumes conventional DRAM capacity and Yuanta expects supply tightness into 2028.
web_customers: Concentration is high. On Jul 30 2026 Samsung said it completed five-year multi-year contracts with five global hyperscalers and was in final talks with five more AI clients; HBM3E/HBM4 ships to all related customers including Nvidia, whose Vera Rubin platform drives 3Q26 HBM4 volume. Foundry serves AI logic (4nm LPU) customers.
web_who_loses: SK hynix and Micron lose if Samsung wins HBM4 share and pricing power. Samsung's own DX division loses: it posted a KRW0.8tn operating loss in 2Q26 as memory cost inflation squeezed smartphone and TV margins, the chipflation paradox. Device, PC and phone makers that buy DRAM/NAND pay more.
web_contradicting_evidence: Kiwoom cut 3Q26 revenue to KRW198tn and operating profit to KRW107tn while keeping a KRW350000 target, far below consensus. FnGuide consensus fell 2.6pc on revenue and 4.4pc on operating profit over three months on currency effects. DRAM ASP growth decelerates from 16.5pc to 5.4pc; LTAs cap spot upside; 2028 capacity additions and HBM peak-out debate persist; DX is lossmaking.
web_if_management_right: HBM4 exceeds 60pc of HBM revenue in 2H26, 3Q26 HBM4 revenue triples QoQ, foundry returns to quarterly profit for the first time since 2023, and LTA-backed 60-70pc of capacity smooths the cycle. Yuanta projects 2027 revenue of KRW1193.5tn and operating profit of KRW590.5tn, funding larger 2027-2029 returns.
web_if_management_wrong: Memory ASP growth stalls faster than expected, HBM4 yields or customer certification disappoint, and the peak-out 2028 trade returns. Foundry stays lossmaking, DX losses widen, and LTAs lock in volumes while capping pricing upside. Valuation multiple compresses and Korean memory stays viewed as cyclical despite record profits.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: EUV and fab-equipment suppliers such as ASML, Applied Materials and Lam; HBM substrate, base-die and advanced-packaging/test vendors; Nvidia's Vera Rubin supply chain. Korean brokers and asset managers gain from record turnover and dividend flows, and group affiliates benefit from Samsung capex. AI server and cloud builders get scarce capacity.
